summary: First test of the new FastAPI+Mongo backend (Phase 1). Backend: 24 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_api.py, 21 pass and 3 fail. The 3 failures are a CRITICAL price exploit using negative quantity, a broken brute-force lockout behind the ingress, and a missing POST /api/ach. UI checks via Playwright: login with the captcha, register (password of 12+ chars), sidebar logout, product purchase from /shop (wallet charged, order shown on /orders), card purchase on /cards with the rank discount applied ($2.00 -> $1.96), redeem code once then 'Invalid or used code' toast, /ranks with the leaderboard modal, /profile tabs and password change, /support, /cart, /free-card, /my-deposits and all 13 admin sections. None of these crashed. One page breaks: /deposit crashes for any user who has a redeem deposit (DepositRow reads deposit.type, but /api/deposits does not return 'type'). It also shows the inline error '["/api/payments/crypto/currencies"] data is undefined' for every user.

critical.issue: SECURITY/PRICE EXPLOIT: quantity is not validated. items:[{variantId:A(qty 1,$10)},{variantId:B(qty -1,$9)}] creates an order for total $1.00, and the buyer still receives A's stock. Verified live: order total=100 for a $10 item. raw += price*qty accepts negative and zero values. Fix: require isinstance(qty,int) and qty>=1 (and >= variant.minQuantity), and reject unknown fields such as a negative-priced card list.

The lockout identifier uses request.client.host. That is the ingress pod IP (seen as 10.211.1.135 and 10.211.1.136 for the same client), so failures are spread across several identifiers. 6 wrong passwords in a row all returned 401 and never 429. Fix: take the first IP from X-Forwarded-For, or also add an email-only counter. Also reset 'count' when lockedUntil has passed; today the count stays at 5 or more forever, so one later failure locks the account again right away.

Rows are returned as {id,amount,status,method,description,createdAt} with no 'type' field. DepositPage's DepositRow calls deposit.type.charAt() and the whole /deposit page crashes (React error, page goes blank) for any user with a redeem-code deposit, e.g. buyer1. The old Node endpoint returned only crypto/manual deposit rows, each with a 'type'. Fix: add type (e.g. 'code' or 'manual'), or return [] for code redeems as the old API did.

minor.issue: Not implemented, so the catch-all returns 501 'coming soon'. AdminPage 'Add ACH' (single) calls POST /api/ach {bankName,balance,fullItem,price dollars}. The old routes.ts:3422 had this endpoint. Only bulk add works.

The stub returns []. The hook use-crypto-currencies.ts reads response.currencies, so the query data is undefined and /deposit shows red text: '["/api/payments/crypto/currencies"] data is undefined'. The stub should return {"currencies": []}.

The backend accepts 8 characters (MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH=8). The old backend and the frontend AuthPage enforce 12, so register/reset/change behave differently in the UI and the API. Align them (12 for parity).

POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/replace, POST /api/admin/test-order, POST /api/admin/clear-all-data and POST /api/upload (product image) all fall through to 501, but the old server and the Admin UI have them. Confirm whether they are intentionally deferred.
valid_discount() used during order creation does not enforce minOrder. Only /discount/validate checks it, so a client can send discountCodeId directly on a cart below the minimum.
Not atomic: it reads the status, then credits. Two concurrent refunds can both credit the wallet. Use find_one_and_update({id, status:{$ne:'refunded'}}) before crediting.
Check-then-act race: claimedToday is counted before the cards are claimed, so parallel requests can go over the daily allowance.

ui_bugs.issue: The page crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading charAt)' for users with deposits. The root cause is the backend /api/deposits response shape.
Shows the error text '["/api/payments/crypto/currencies"] data is undefined' because the stub returns the wrong shape.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/ach returns 501, so admins cannot add a single ACH from the UI.

OrdersPage uses hard-coded tiers: $50 deposits shows 'Bronze 5% off' and $600 shows 'Gold 15% off'. The backend applies 0%/2%/5%/10% at <$100/$100/$500/$1000, so the label misleads buyers about their discount. This is in the unchanged frontend, but it no longer matches /api/user/rank.

issues: The table is cut off on the right: the Price, PricePerCard and Actions columns are hidden past 'Base / Uploader', so per-card buy buttons are not visible without horizontal scroll.
The admin console uses h-screen inside the site Layout header, which leaves a ~200px empty black band at the bottom of the viewport.

action_items: CRITICAL: validate item quantity in POST /api/orders (int >= 1, >= minQuantity, sane upper bound). Reject negative or zero values. Re-run TestShop::test_negative_quantity_rejected.
Fix the login lockout key so it works behind the ingress (X-Forwarded-For first hop, or an email-based counter), and reset the counter after lockedUntil expires.
Add a 'type' field to /api/deposits rows, or exclude code redeems as the old API did, so /deposit stops crashing.
Implement POST /api/ach (admin single add, price in dollars converted to cents, 201).
Align password min length with the frontend and old backend (12).
Make the refund idempotent/atomic; enforce discount minOrder in create_order.
Optionally implement or confirm deferral of admin orders replace, test-order, clear-all-data and /api/upload.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_shop.create_order: quantity is trusted from the client (negative/zero/huge). It is also not checked against variant.minQuantity on the server.
auth.login: request.client.host behind the k8s ingress is not the client IP. Lockout is ineffective, and with a single ingress IP it would lock all users of the same email together.
routes_admin.refund and routes_user.free_claim have check-then-act races. Use conditional find_one_and_update.
routes_user.free_card_status imports timedelta inside the function; move it to module level (minor). routes_shop.create_order imports json inside the handler (minor).
GET /api/admin/users is available to workers (staff_user) and exposes every user's email and balance. This matches the old server, but consider limiting it to admins.
Dashboard totalSales counts only status 'fulfilled'. Product orders are created as 'delivering', so sales are under-reported. The old server did the same; consider including 'delivering'.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all tested pages and flows work except the /deposit crash for users with deposits)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_api.py. The 3 expected failures until fixed are test_login_wrong_and_lockout, test_negative_quantity_rejected and test_ach_single_create. For UI, avoid page.goto reloads (Cloudflare returns 429 and a challenge after ~6 full navigations). Log in once via /auth (captcha = text of '.spider-captcha svg text' nodes) and navigate with history.pushState + popstate. The register UI requires a password of 12+ characters. In the browser tool, avoid backslash-n in Python strings and str.replace (the tool rewrites scripts).
rca of the issue: 1) Negative qty: create_order sums v.price*int(quantity) with no lower bound, and range(negative) reserves nothing, so a negative line subtracts from the total. 2) Lockout: identifier=f'{request.client.host}:{email}', and client.host varies between ingress pods (login_attempts collection shows 2 docs for one email with counts 2 and 4). 3) /deposit crash: routes_user.my_deposits emits 'method' but DepositPage's Deposit type needs 'type'; DepositRow calls deposit.type.charAt(0).
